l.i: Seruire Sermas nos iuuat. Hic sua
Et signa nobis dans eadem inclyti
Manus ad astra suscitat, mox annuit
Secum, iubente sic Deo, me ducere
Parat Moriia ad alta montis culmina:
Meque interesse Cultu sacras quum fumidis
Sic sic procul nostris remotas adibus
Lustrabo gentes, et solum Vijam exterum.
O nunc eundum est: O, meus Venit parens,
Iam Cult paratus omnibus Viam ingredi.

page.notes: Ornamental woodcut band between the verse and the act heading. Several words in the verse are doubtful (Greek-looking glyphs such as "Sermas", "Cultu", "Vijam", "Venit" are uncertain). Catchword partly cut off at the page edge.
